title: Normal (tricky): the real bank checks a charge and asks for nothing

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, this is the card security team at Sunshine Community Bank. We saw a $45 charge at a Target in Orlando and want to make sure it was you.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Orlando? No, I haven't been there.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thank you. We've blocked that card, and a new one will come in the mail in about a week.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Do you need my card number or anything?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, and we'll never ask for your PIN, a code, or for you to move money. If you have questions, call the number on the back of your card.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Okay, thank you for catching it.
